answer_1.quote: We test the performance of our methods on both NLU and NLG tasks. For NLG tasks, we use GPT-2 SMALL for NLG tasks: WebNLG-challenge focuses on table-to-text tasks, in which the language models generate some relatively long and sensible sentences based on the triples with solely a few words; in contrast, CoQA provides the data for conversational question answering, which requires the language model to return short answers to questions based on long conversational materials.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences for table-to-text tasks and short answers for conversational question answering
